summary: Frontend-only verification for (1) admin sidebar submenu 'Configuracion' with 5 sub-items in expected order, and (2) Onboarding CTAs pointing to existing routes. Both tasks verified successfully.

issues: CTAs of pending steps are rendered as <button> (using useNavigate), not wrapped in <a href> anchor tags. Functionality works (navigation succeeds), but semantically a <Link> would be preferable for SEO / middle-click open-in-new-tab / accessibility. The review_request mentioned 'devuelve 200' — verified navigation works and target routes render (no 404). Non-blocking.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Consider wrapping onboarding CTAs in <Link to={step.href}> instead of <Button onClick={navigate}> for better semantics (middle-click new tab, right-click menu). Not blocking.

All submenu items render as <a> tags (react-router NavLink), so href attributes exist and links are semantically correct.
All 9 routes (/settings,/branches,/users,/my-plan,/support,/inventory,/patients,/sales,/onboarding) load without 404 for admin user.
Onboarding step 1 (change_password) has href=null and action='open_password_dialog' — could not click-test because paso 1 was already completed on seed admin, but code is correct per file inspection.
